thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — marketing is drafting the launch post and we want to include a verified claim about cost improvements on quantized models. Request: a holdback-style validation where 10% of the benchmark payloads are held out as an independent QA bucket. Need methodology, exact sample selection, seeds, warmup policy, and a short runbook. Target: results and artifacts by next Tue EOD (5 days). :eyes:
sam: Got it. Which model variant and quantization profile are we claiming? Also: do you want latency and generation-quality checks, or just cost per-token numbers?
maya: Primary claim will reference the "redwood-65b" family vs the quantized 4-bit variant. We want both cost/unit (tokens) and a simple quality sanity check (log-prob drop + a small set of golden prompts). Will rely on our usual benchmark payload set but want the 10% holdback separated and not used for warmup/cache. Link to payload list: https://redwood.internal/s/bench/payloads (private).
sam: OK. Proposed minimal methodology: 1) deterministic holdback: use hash(payload_id) mod 10 == 0 for the 10% holdout, record the seed and selection script in artifacts. 2) For each variant run: flush KV cache, run warmup N=50 requests distributed across seq lengths, then run the full sweep. 3) Capture per-payload latency, token count, model logits for golden set. 4) Compute cost per token and delta vs baseline.
alex: small note on warmup: prefer request-sliced warmup (mix of short/long) to match production seq length distribution. Also run a single quantized cold start to sanity-check loading time.
sam: I'll put together a runnable job. Quick example command to run locally/in CI:```bash
run_bench \--input gs://bench/payloads/master.json \--holdback-rule "hash(id)%10==0" \--seed 42 \--quant 4 \--warmup 50 \--out artifacts/holdback-1742003145.csv
```
sam: Plan: 1) smoke canary with 100 samples to validate warmup/wiring (~30m). 2) full run for baseline and quantized (~3-4h depending on QPS). 3) upload artifacts (CSV + per-payload diffs + seed/selection script) to artifacts bucket and post a short summary in this thread.
maya: Great — please include p95 latency, p50, median token cost, and the golden-set quality diff. Also export a small CSV for marketing with benchmarking headlines (single row summary + a link to the raw artifacts).
tanya: Can we also get a simple failure mode note? e.g., if quantized model has >2% golden-set accuracy drop or >15% p95 latency increase then flag as "requires manual review".
sam: Yep — adding those thresholds. Will also record model commit hash, quantization config, and the exact kernel selection used.
benchbot: Job queued: bench-holdback-1742003145-canary (owner: sam). Estimated runtime: canary 30m, full 4h. Artifacts path: s3://redwood-artifacts/holdback/1742003145/
sam: Canary started. Posting smoke logs to the artifacts path.
sam: Canary green. No obvious regressions on golden-set. Queueing full run now.
maya: Amazing — thank you! :thumbsup: Please ping with the summary CSV and the short blurb we can paste into the blog.
sam: Will do. Summary expected in ~5h, will attach artifacts and a short 3-line marketing blurb.
